title: 100 km2 Mesh, Outlet 27, Rivers only, 30% buffer
deck: 100 km2 catchment mesh where only rivers constrain the internal mesh, while the watershed boundary and outside coarsening remain active on a 30% buffered support.
summary: This case is reserved for a catchment mesh where geology is removed from the internal constraint set, but the watershed boundary, support extent, and outside de-refinement stay aligned with the standard gallery workflow.
what_it_shows: How the river network alone structures the internal conformal mesh when geology is not enforced.
How the same buffered watershed support can be compared fairly against the geology-plus-rivers variant.
How outside coarsening still protects the basin focus while simplifying the external region.
